label: Week 41, 2026
recap:
The week was quiet, with six bill movements and eighteen case updates across three jurisdictions. New Jersey led with three, Pennsylvania had two, and the United States Congress had one. Six themes appeared once each: criminal law, government use, privacy and data, safety and frontier models, transparency and disclosure, and workforce and education. Two bills carried no theme.

Activity was spread thin rather than concentrated. No federal documents appeared, and no agencies were named. The case updates outnumbered bill movements, though the data does not say what those cases concerned.
